asks: Keep the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary unchanged, including the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16.
Do not put part of Beaumont in Strathcona-Sherwood Park; Strathcona County and Beaumont should each have their own MLAs.
Leave Strathcona-Sherwood Park as it is: no Beaumont, keep Heritage Hills, and add Tofield if population must be added.
Do not turn Lethbridge's two districts into four that take in surrounding rural communities.

quote: The proposed changes to turn the Lethbridge riding from 2 to 4 districts would not benefit the province.
note: Writer calls the four-district plan 'the proposed changes' though the interim map kept two city districts; header is about Lethbridge-West. Argues against adding rural communities such as Taber and Coaldale to city districts. No positive request stated, so rejects only.

asks: Leave Strathcona-Sherwood Park as it is: no Beaumont, keep Heritage Hills, and add Tofield if population must be added (same text as 0426).
Reconsider putting Coaldale and Lethbridge County in Livingstone-Macleod; offers an attached map of an alternative.

quote: Livingstone-Macleod, should the proposal be accepted, would become predominantly a Lethbridge commuters riding
note: Request is about Coaldale and Lethbridge County in Livingstone-Macleod, not about how the city is divided. An attached map ('Lethbridge Region.png', p. 73) is unreadable in the OCR text and the PDF was not available to me; it may carry more.

asks: Take Springbank out of the interim Cochrane-Springbank district and put it in a Calgary-based district such as Calgary-Bow.

quote: express concern with the proposal to place Springbank within the new Cochrane-Springbank electoral division
note: Springbank resident wants Springbank in a Calgary-based district (names Calgary-Bow), so objects to the Springbank half of the interim Cochrane-Springbank district. Says nothing of where Cochrane itself should go. A second reader might leave rejects blank.

quote: a hybrid constituency dominated by Cochrane and Airdrie priorities
note: Airdrie named in passing; no request about it.

asks: No change requested; supports the interim map and the added seat in Edmonton Southwest.
Do not divide Beaumont; keep it in Leduc County's riding, not Strathcona's.
Keep Langdon with Chestermere and Strathmore as the interim map does, add Carseland, and consider the name Chestermere-Strathmore-Langdon.

quote: it’s important that Langdon remains in the same constituency as Chestermere and Strathmore, and I’m glad to see that the draft boundaries maintain this
note: Langdon resident endorses the interim Chestermere-Strathmore district; contrasts it with Calgary-based districts for Conrich and Prince of Peace. Also asks to add Carseland and to rename it Chestermere-Strathmore-Langdon.

asks: Do not split urban centres and pair them with rural areas, naming Edmonton and Lethbridge.

quote: our urban centres in Edmonton and Lethbridge that have been proposed to be paired up in ways that just don't make sense. I urge you, do not go through with this!
note: Edmonton writer objects to pairing urban centres with rural ones and names Lethbridge. Believes such pairing 'has been proposed'; the interim map did not do it for Lethbridge. No positive request for Lethbridge beyond the objection.

asks: Do not split Beaumont.
Keep Edmonton-City Centre (downtown) as proposed and do not blend it with suburbs.
Add another seat each to Edmonton and Calgary and avoid hybrid ridings, particularly in south and south-west Edmonton.
Adopt a four-quadrant hybrid approach for the Lethbridge region.

quote: For these reasons, I strongly encourage the adoption of a four-quadrant hybrid approach for the Lethbridge region.
note: Raymond resident; header about Cardston-Taber-Warner. Asks for the four-quadrant hybrid by name.

asks: Do not divide Beaumont.
Make the Taber constituency run from Lethbridge County east to Bow Island along Highway 3, and 'reconsider' the four-quadrant hybrid model for Lethbridge.

quote: I encourage the boundary commission to reconsider the four-quadrant hybrid model for Lethbridge.
note: Ambiguous. Former MLA; header about Lethbridge-East. 'Reconsider' most likely means take the four-quadrant model up again (the interim map did not adopt it), which would be L2 exact; it could also be read as think again about it. Left without a want under the doubt rule. His main request is a Taber constituency from Lethbridge County east to Bow Island along Highway 3.

asks: Keep the current Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West boundaries and do not fold the city into surrounding rural areas.

quote: I am writing to express my support for maintaining the current electoral boundaries in the ridings of Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West.
note: Rejection shown at p. 100: 'Dividing these boundaries would risk diluting the urban voice by subsuming it within surrounding rural communities'. Rejects joining the city to rural areas in general; the four-way plan is not described.

asks: Replace the interim Banff-Jasper district with a Canmore-Crowsnest Pass district linking the Bow Valley and the southern Rockies.

quote: avoiding the interim’s awkward extensions into Clearwater County or Foothills fragments
note: Canmore resident asks for a Canmore-Crowsnest Pass district in place of Banff-Jasper (a CANMORE-JASPER matter). One clause objects to Banff-Jasper reaching into Clearwater County. No request about Rocky Mountain House.

quote: avoiding the interim’s awkward extensions into Clearwater County or Foothills fragments
note: Clearwater County named once, as part of the interim Banff-Jasper district; no request about the Rocky Mountain House riding.

asks: Do not divide Beaumont; keep all of it in Leduc-Beaumont.

Keep a stand-alone Sherwood Park riding, and do not put half of Beaumont in Strathcona-Sherwood Park.
Reconsider adding Montgomery to Calgary-Varsity; keep Montgomery with Bowness, given growth in University District.
No clear request; says further change will confuse Strathcona County electors.
Keep all of Beaumont in one electoral division.
Keep Coaldale in its current district (Taber-Warner) within the Highway 3 corridor.

quote: Residents of Coaldale routinely travel to Lethbridge and neighbouring communities for
note: Coaldale resident asks that Coaldale stay in its current district (Taber-Warner). Describes Lethbridge as the regional anchor of the Highway 3 corridor but does not ask that Coaldale share a district with any part of the city.

asks: Make all of Medicine Hat one urban riding.
Keep Edmonton districts along municipal lines and give Edmonton one more seat.
Leave Coaldale in Taber-Warner with the Highway 3 agri-food corridor.
No change requested; supports the interim Edmonton-West Henday boundaries inside city limits.

note: Edmonton writer raised in Lethbridge. Approves the interim's two city districts and names the four-way split with rural areas as the thing rightly avoided.

asks: Give Medicine Hat one urban MLA.
Do not split Beaumont; leave it as it is.
Give Medicine Hat its own urban riding instead of splitting the city between two rural ridings.
Align Edmonton districts with neighbourhoods and community leagues, keep them inside the city, do not split Beaumont, and add one more Edmonton seat.
Do not split Beaumont at 50th Street; keep it whole and out of an Edmonton riding.
Seriously consider a mix of urban and rural areas and more ridings around Lethbridge.

quote: Consideration of a mix of urban and rural areas and increased ridings around Lethbridge should be seriously looked at. It is concerning that this view has not been taken in the latest report.
note: Lethbridge resident; header about Lethbridge-East. Asks for urban-rural mix and more ridings around Lethbridge without describing four quadrants.

asks: No change requested; supports the interim map, urban-only north Edmonton districts and the added Edmonton seat.
Keep all of Beaumont in Leduc-Beaumont.

No explicit request; ridicules splitting a city in two (header: Beaumont, Leduc-Beaumont).

Keep Edmonton, Calgary, Lethbridge and other urban ridings inside city limits; no urban-rural hybrids.

note: Edmonton writer. Wants city-only districts for Lethbridge among others; does not say how many. Also p. 47: 'combining urban and rural areas into hybrid ridings is not the right solution'.

asks: No change requested; supports the Calgary changes and asks that future urban growth be taken into account.

note: Letter is about Calgary-Shaw and Calgary-Okotoks. Lethbridge is listed among the 'largest cities' where the small-town hybrid model does not apply; an example, not a request (rule 6).

quote: clearly appropriate to be applied to areas outside of our largest cities – Edmonton, Calgary, Red Deer and Lethbridge
note: Letter is about Calgary-Shaw and Calgary-Okotoks. Red Deer is listed among the 'largest cities' where the small-town hybrid model does not apply; an example, not a request (rule 6).

quote: a better option would be to keep Clearwater County in a single constituency and align it with other western communities
note: Wild Rose School Division board. The firm request is Clearwater County whole in one constituency (W0); 'align it with other western communities' and the Highway 22 corridor point to a western district rather than Lacombe, hence W1 at direction. Sundre and Lacombe are not named in the request. Rejection of the three-way split, p. 89: 'Placing Clearwater County into three different constituencies will reduce the effective representation'.

quote: a catchment reaching as far east as Condor and as far west as Banff National Park
note: Banff National Park named only as the western edge of the school division's catchment; Banff-Jasper named as one of three interim districts dividing Clearwater County. No request about joining park land to the Rocky Mountain House riding.
